extracted.name: Garlic Mayonnaise Aioli
extracted.description: This lemony garlic aioli is a mayonnaise-based dip that you can whip up in minutes and serve alongside a range of appetizers or seafood mains.
ingredient_lines: 3 cloves garlic, crushed, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Mix mayonnaise, mustard, and salt together in a bowl. Stir in garlic and lemon juice. Cover and refrigerate until serving.
